hero.headline: India's trusted village livestock marketplace
hero.subhead: Buy and sell cows, buffalo, and goats directly with verified farmers. No middlemen, no fake listings.

buyers.heading: For buyers
buyers.step1Body: Search livestock by type, breed, location, and price.
buyers.step2Body: Photos, breed, age, milk yield, calving history — all visible upfront.
buyers.step3Body: Open the app and talk directly to a verified seller.

sellers.heading: For sellers
sellers.step1Body: Add photos, breed, age, price. Five simple steps.
sellers.step2Body: Thousands of verified buyers in your region see your listing.
sellers.step3Body: Keep the full price. No commission, no middleman.

features.title: Why Pashubazaar
features.subtitle: Built for rural India — not for fancy Silicon Valley
features.f1Body: Multiple photos, breed, age, milk yield, calving history. No filters, no fakery.
features.f2Body: Every seller's phone is verified. No throwaway numbers, no fake listings.
features.f3Body: Marathi, Hindi, English — built for the farmers who use it, in the language they speak.
features.f4Body: No subscription, no commission. Listings stay live for 30 days.

b2b.title: Are you a vet, feed brand, or financier?
b2b.body: Reach thousands of farmers across Maharashtra and India. Let's talk about partnership opportunities.

ctaBand.title: Start buying or selling today
ctaBand.body: Free. Mobile-first. Built for Indian farmers.

about.title: Who we are
about.lede: Pashubazaar began with a simple observation: in rural India, livestock trade still happens through WhatsApp groups, with fake listings and no price transparency. We're fixing that.
about.missionBody: Give every Indian farmer a trustworthy livestock marketplace — in their own language, on their own phone.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you
contact.supportBody: Questions about the app, your account, or a listing? Email us.
contact.partnerBody: Veterinary services, feed brands, finance — let's talk.

download.title: Download the Pashubazaar app
download.subtitle: The village marketplace, on your phone. Free. In Marathi, Hindi, and English.
download.comingSoonBody: Email us to get notified the moment it goes live.
download.pwaBody: Use without the app store. Open in your browser and add to your home screen.

legal.title: Legal
legal.privacyP1: This is a placeholder Privacy Policy. It will be replaced once reviewed by counsel.
legal.privacyP2: Pashubazaar collects only what is needed to operate the service: phone number (OTP verified), name, location, and listing details. We do not sell your data to third parties.
legal.termsP1: These are placeholder Terms of Service. They will be replaced once reviewed by counsel.
legal.termsP2: Pashubazaar is a marketplace that connects buyers and sellers. We do not own the livestock listed, and we are not a party to transactions between users.
legal.termsP3: Fake listings, fraud, and abuse are grounds for account termination.
legal.refundP1: Listing on Pashubazaar is currently free. No payments are processed through the app — buyers and sellers transact directly.
legal.refundP2: If paid features are added in the future, the refund policy will be published here.
legal.refundP3: Dispute with a seller or buyer? Email details to hello@pashubazaar.com.
